definitions.explanation: The sale of a product in restricted quantities, for a limited time, or only at certain locations, creating a sense of exclusivity. Often used with する.

examples.japanese: {期間|きかん}{限定販売|げんていはんばい}の{商品|しょうひん}。
このお{菓子|かし}は{地域|ちいき}{限定販売|げんていはんばい}だ。
examples.english: This snack is sold only in certain regions.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}ブランドが{新色|しんしょく}を{限定販売|げんていはんばい}すると{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: A popular brand announced it would sell a new color in a limited release.

notes:
Composed of {限定|げんてい} (limitation) + {販売|はんばい} (selling). Takes する to become a verb ({限定販売|げんていはんばい}する, to sell in a limited release).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {期間|きかん}{限定販売|げんていはんばい}: limited-time sale
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定販売|げんていはんばい}: limited-quantity sale
- {店舗|てんぽ}{限定販売|げんていはんばい}: store-exclusive sale

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {限定|げんてい}{商品|しょうひん}: limited-edition product — the item itself, not the act of selling
- {通常|つうじょう}{販売|はんばい}: regular sale — the unrestricted opposite
